restaurant_name: P&P Therapy clinic พีแอนด์พีคลินิกกายภาพบำบัด
text: Messaged asked, if they do remedial deep tissue massage, for two bulged disks lower back.30 minutes in all I had was a heat pack and them rub a $5 massage gun all over my back in no particular pattern. I then endured him shoving his full body weight directly on my lower vertebrae , and proceed to just pull on my skin and karate chop my back for another half hour. Went no where near my glutes for a lower back problem. I left half way through a 90 minute session in disgust. I’ve never felt so angry and ripped off from a medical appointment in my entire life. You would be better off going to see a witch doctor. I question if this clinic is even real ,or if they are even physiotherapists. I just did 3 physiotherapy sessions a week in Kuala Lumpur for the last 12 weeks which was brilliant. Absolutely do not go here if you expect any treatment, or don’t want to leave more injured than when you went in.
